study_note: Seed-55 matched control for the exploratory 14-million-decision Humanoid Walk behavior-regularizer screen; one training seed does not support a confidence or significance claim. The distributional critic trains five heads and every configured actor/target reduction samples two distinct heads and takes their minimum. Both critic targets remain reward-only, and automatic outer temperature tuning uses the normalized rho-weighted actor-depth mixture. At step zero and every 50,000 decisions, the observational evaluation runs the 100-sample fixed-seed Q-versus-MC protocols and five seed-12345 paired real-environment episodes comparing deterministic outer control with deterministic execution after a fresh action-local inner SAC solve at every state. The primary improvement signal is eval/paired_fresh_inner_minus_outer; with inner_diagnostic_rollouts=0, the evaluator also records the fixed-target root-Q action-gain distribution without extra diagnostic model rollouts. Positive predicted Q gain with negative real return delta indicates critic/model optimism or compounded distribution shift. These probes add substantial evaluation-only compute that is timed separately; they do not alter training or consume its decision budget.
